failure_reason: Argos homepage (/) and every /browse/* category page returned Akamai Bot Manager 403 'Access Denied' on all attempts across all three access tiers tried live today: curl_cffi impersonating 7 browser profiles (chrome124, chrome120, chrome131, safari184_ios, safari18_0_ios, safari15_5, edge101), Playwright headless Chromium, and a real Claude-in-Chrome browser session. This blocks direct inspection of the site's main nav/mega-menu and any per-category 'New In' tab/sort/filter. No archive/proxy substitute (Wayback, r.jina.ai, translate.goog) was used per rules, so this conclusion rests on the other live-reachable evidence described in notes rather than a full nav traversal.
notes: Despite the homepage/browse block, extensive live evidence points to no genuine New Arrivals PLP existing for Home & Furniture: (1) Direct slug probing -- /new-in, /new-arrivals, /just-in, /whats-new, /latest-arrivals, /new-collection, /newin all returned a real, consistent site 404 template (3690 bytes) across profiles, proving the path namespace is reachable (not blocked) and these routes simply don't exist. (2) Found /features/new-in (HTTP 200) but its Next.js payload is a plain CMS 'composition' (no productMetadata field anywhere, confirmed by full-text search of the parsed JSON) -- opening it shows it is Argos's 'A-List' editorial/brand-spotlight page: its only outbound links are to brand pages (/brands/apple, /brands/dyson, /brands/lego, /brands/sony, /brands/amazon-devices, /brands/instax) and generic whole-department browse/search links (Appliances, Health & Beauty, Technology, Sports & Leisure) -- no Home & Furniture-specific new-arrivals product listing anywhere on it. Excluded per the brief's marketing/editorial-page rule. (3) /list/new-in/ returns HTTP 200 but is the same generic templated search-results fallback identified for Bestsellers: title 'Results for new in', meta robots=noindex, canned 'Get set for new in at Argos' description, and an identical response pattern reproduces for a nonsense slug (/list/zzznonsenseterm123/) -- excluded per the brief's search-results-page rule. (4) Sitemap enumeration -- fetched and regex-searched all reachable sitemaps (browse_sitemap.xml: 1492 URLs, browse_refined_sitemap.xml: 7235 URLs, sd_sitemap.xml: 4226 URLs, other_sitemap.xml, features_events_sitemap.xml) for new-in/new-arrival/just-in/latest keywords combined with home/furniture/garden -- zero in-scope hits; the only keyword match anywhere was an out-of-scope Health & Beauty page, /sd/shop-new-in-fragrance-at-argos/ (Fragrance department, not Home & Furniture). (5) The live, un-filtered Home & Furniture category tree (from the accessible /clearance/home-and-furniture/c:29351/ page's embedded categoryData) exposes only 5 mega-menu section headings -- 'Popular Now', 'Furniture by Room', 'Furnishings and Decor', 'Kitchen and Dining', 'Household' -- none named New In/New Arrivals/Just In. No genuine New Arrivals concept was found anywhere reachable; the residual gap is only the blocked homepage mega-menu and live /browse/* pages (where an individual category's own 'New in' sort/filter, if any, would be an excluded arbitrary-filter view of an existing category rather than a distinct PLP in any case), which is why status is 'partial' rather than 'ok'.
